title: Layout rule
description: One reusable, machine-checkable planning rule distilled from one or more cases. One line of data/layout_rules/rules.jsonl. Never a flat fact: every rule names whose opinion it is.

statement.description: The rule in one sentence, in the practitioner's terms.

statement_ru.description: Original Russian phrasing, kept for searchability.

params.description: Numeric parameters with unit-suffixed keys, so a checker can evaluate a candidate layout against them directly.

condition.description: When the rule applies - e.g. 'only when the wall carries an acoustic layer'. Empty means unconditional in the source.

regulation_ref.description: Only when the source cites a norm (SNiP/SP/etc.) - record the citation, not our own reading of it.

confidence.description: contested means another sourced rule in this file disagrees - see conflicts_with.

conflicts_with.description: rule_ids that disagree. Disagreement is kept, not resolved.

wiki_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the prose page carrying the reasoning.
